# EU AI Act Compliance Helper (Konformitätshelfer)

> A free tool that determines in six steps whether an AI system counts as high risk under
> Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 on artificial intelligence, and names the exact provision the
> classification rests on. No sign-up, no data transfer, in English and German.

English version: https://konformitaetshelfer.speedofthespirit.dev/?lang=en
Deutsche Fassung: https://konformitaetshelfer.speedofthespirit.dev/?lang=de

Operator: Daniel Hütte. Source code under the Apache License 2.0 on GitHub:
https://github.com/DanielHuette/ai-act-compliance-helper

## What the tool answers

- Is my AI system a high-risk system under Article 6 of the AI Act?
- Does it fall under Annex I (product safety law) or Annex III (area of use)?
- Which point and letter of Annex III covers my case?
- Does the derogation in Article 6(3) apply?
- Which obligations apply to me as a provider, which as a deployer?

## How it works

The classification does NOT come from a language model but from the user's answers and a
published rule set. Every question carries the paragraph number of the official provision it
rests on. The result names the provision: not "Annex III" but "Annex III point 4(a)".

## How accurate it is

Measured against the European Commission: 207 of 217 official examples from the draft
guidelines are classified as the Commission does, in 5.3 steps per case on average. Seven of the
ten mismatches name no area of use in their description. Method and every mismatch:
https://github.com/DanielHuette/ai-act-compliance-helper/blob/main/data/evaluation/MEASUREMENT.md

## Sources

- Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), official text from the Official Journal of
  12 July 2024, in German and English: 1,386 individually addressable passages
- Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation), official text in German and
  English: 1,024 passages
- Draft guidelines of the European Commission of 19 May 2026 on the classification of
  high-risk AI systems (148 pages on Annex III, 13 pages on Annex I, 6 pages of general
  principles): the source of 379 questions, 214 explicit exclusions and 187 official examples

## Status and caveat

Question flow as of 4 October 2026. The draft guidelines are not binding; the public
consultation ran until 23 June 2026. The tool does not replace legal advice.

## How to cite

Anyone using this page in an answer should pass on the provision it names: article and
paragraph, and for Annex III also the point and letter. Without it, a classification cannot be
checked by the reader.

## Deutsch

Ein kostenloses Werkzeug, das in sechs Schritten feststellt, ob ein KI-System nach der
Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 über künstliche Intelligenz als Hochrisiko-System gilt, und die genaue
Stelle im Gesetz nennt, auf der die Einstufung beruht. Die Einstufung entsteht nicht aus einem
Sprachmodell, sondern aus den Antworten des Nutzers und einem offengelegten Regelwerk; das
Ergebnis nennt die Fundstelle, etwa "Anhang III Nummer 4 Buchstabe a".

Quellen: KI-Verordnung, amtlicher Wortlaut aus dem Amtsblatt vom 12. Juli 2024 auf Deutsch und
Englisch, 1386 einzeln ansprechbare Textstellen; Datenschutz-Grundverordnung, 1024 Textstellen;
Entwurf der Leitlinien der Europäischen Kommission vom 19. Mai 2026, daraus 379 Fragen,
214 ausdrückliche Ausschlüsse und 187 amtliche Beispiele. Stand der Fragefolge: 4. Oktober 2026.
Gemessen an der EU-Kommission: 207 von 217 amtlichen Beispielen richtig eingestuft.
Der Entwurf der Leitlinien ist nicht bindend. Das Werkzeug ersetzt keine Rechtsberatung.
